name: Card
purpose: Wrap arbitrary content in an optional theme-aware surface and border with rounded corners.
intent: A surface shell with a single unrestricted children slot. Content owns padding, layout, semantics, and interactions. Tier exception: it lives with organisms as a container for complete content sections, while importing no other UI components.

figmaSource.verificationMethod: Figma Console: all variant dimensions, padding, clipping, stroke alignment/weight, effects, native slots, and bound surface/radius/border variables.
apiAdaptationNotes: Native Figma slot#4968:0 maps to React children, with no extra wrapper or prescribed content components.
Radius labels map to semantic keys lg/xl/xxl. Defaults are raised, lg, and border=true.
Master dimensions are demonstration sizes, not a fixed code size.
The single slot fills the master; its horizontal/vertical authoring direction does not impose a content layout in code.
Border=true has an inside 1px default stroke; border=false has no stroke or reserved border width. All variants retain clipping, zero padding and gap, and no shadow.
Surface=none has no fill and maps to transparent, independently of the border. It does not apply opacity to children.

useCases: A surface around a form or list
Transparent panels with an optional outline and rounded clipping
antiPatterns: Using Card as a whole-card button or link
Expecting a built-in header, footer, padding, or shadow
Adding a card where ordinary layout needs no surface, border, or clipping

anatomy.description: Border-box surface with an optional 1px border, radius, and clipped overflow; surface=none is transparent.
Any React content; owns its layout and semantics.

surface.description: Theme-aware surface color; raised adds no shadow and none is transparent.

border.description: Show the 1px default border. False removes both its paint and width.

children.description: Unrestricted slot rendered directly inside the card.

className.description: Composes with the root CSS Module class.

...rest.description: Native div attributes, style, and consumer event handlers.

requirements: Do not add an implicit role or tab stop to the root.
Children provide native semantics, headings, accessible names, and keyboard behavior.
Inset controls enough to preserve focus indicators within the clipped boundary.

behaviorRules: Render arbitrary children directly without cloning or remounting them when variants change.
No card-owned state, hover treatment, focus treatment, or interaction handlers.
Clip content to the radius; use portaled overlays when content must escape the card.
Height follows content and width follows the containing layout unless the consumer supplies dimensions.
Surface and border are independent: border=false removes the border entirely; surface=none removes only the background fill and keeps content fully opaque.
compositionRules: Consumers own layout and padding, including optional headers/footers.
Use existing semantic components inside the slot.
Multiple children and nested cards are supported.
themeRules: Use semantic tokens for every surface, border, and radius; inherit text styling from the content context.
do: Choose surface, border, and radius independently.
Use real buttons and links for interactions inside the card.
dont: Do not bake domain-specific content or actions into Card.
Do not make the generic card shell a click target.
Do not assume raised means a shadow or that Card supplies padding.
acceptanceCriteria: All 30 surface/radius/border combinations match the Figma bindings; no shadows.
Default raised/lg/border=true; no intrinsic dimensions, padding, or typography.
Native attributes and ref are forwarded; children remain directly rendered and preserve state.
Light and dark themes, narrow content, edge clipping, and composed form behavior are verified.
Storybook/MDX, all source docs, generated indexes, and repository validation are complete.
knownLimitations: Clipped overflow requires inset focus indicators and portaled overlays.
Whole-card navigation/selection and named content sections are not part of this surface component.
